The source's hub-to-leaf softmax flux is exactly 42/289 at the patterned positive rational profile (21/17,14/17,14/17;187/153,127/153,127/153), canceling -84/289 hub and 42/289 leaf logistic drift. The chemical equations vanish exactly. An independently reconstructed six-dimensional Jacobian, decomposed into mean chemical -1, leaf-symmetric 3x3 and leaf-antisymmetric 2x2 blocks, has strictly Hurwitz characteristic polynomials: all cubic Routh-Hurwitz coefficients and a1*a2-a3 are positive at the rigorous upper bound chi<28/25, as are the antisymmetric determinant and negative trace. The homogeneous Jacobian modes kappa=0,1/3,1 also have negative trace and positive determinant there. Independent SymPy differentiation of the original six-dimensional ODE and numerical eigenvalues confirmed every eigenvalue is left of the imaginary axis; finite numerical eigenvalues are corroboration, not the proof. Hyperbolic persistence and open positive basins follow locally from standard stability and implicit-function arguments. The result does not classify basins or all equilibria.
